ja.title: Daraxonrasibを分割すると安全になるのか
ja.seo_title: Daraxonrasibの分割投与と全血PK | Daiki Kumakura
ja.summary: 公表ヒトPopPK係数と4,096組の条件付き仮想個体でQDとBIDを比較。ピーク低下と最低濃度上昇を、安全性E–Rの異なる指標から検討する。

en.title: Daraxonrasib dose fractionation: opposing exposure metrics
en.summary: Published daraxonrasib coefficients show opposing peak and minimum-concentration changes after fractionation, with conditional rather than validated safety projections.
en.seo_title: Daraxonrasib: divided dosing and safety associations
en.seo_description: Public PK coefficients compare divided daraxonrasib doses. Lower peaks and higher minima lead to conflicting safety associations, with no validated BID benefit.
